name: Andre Fili
event: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan
summary: A long-serving Team Alpha Male featherweight (27 UFC fights), 36, who has lost two straight, including a TKO to Vinicius Oliveira in June. Many of his fights are close split decisions.

how_they_fight.Striking: Long, busy kickboxer; absorbs more than he lands lately (about 4.6 a minute).
